text:
# MM-P1-L2-HT03-S1 - Lubrication and fluids - Ring Rolling heat treat furnace #3
Revision: Rev E  
Supersedes: Rev D  
Plant: P1, line P1-L2  
Equipment: EQ-P1-L2-HT03

Scope
This procedure covers lubrication and fluid handling for Ring Rolling heat treat furnace #3 (EQ-P1-L2-HT03) in P1, line P1-L2. It defines approved lubricant part number, quench delay requirement, tools required, stepwise procedure for application and inspection, and acceptance criteria. Refer to SOP-P1-L2-01, SOP-P1-L2-02, and SOP-P1-L2-03 for related operational and safety procedures.

Tools
- Approved lubricant: CFW-LUB-652
- Clean lint-free wipes
- Approved dispensing container compatible with CFW-LUB-652
- PPE as required by SOP-P1-L2-02

Procedure
1. Verify equipment is in a safe state per SOP-P1-L2-01 and SOP-P1-L2-03. Confirm work area and PPE.
2. Inspect dispensing container and confirm label matches CFW-LUB-652. Use only CFW-LUB-652 for all lubrication tasks on EQ-P1-L2-HT03.
3. Clean application points with lint-free wipes to remove contaminants prior to lubrication.
4. Apply lubricant sparingly to bearings and sliding interfaces identified in the equipment maintenance diagram. Remove excess immediately to prevent accumulation.
5. For quench operations, ensure the quench delay maximum for Ring Rolling heat treat furnace #3 (EQ-P1-L2-HT03) is 24 seconds. Do not exceed this quench delay maximum.
6. Record lubricant part number applied and any deviations in the maintenance log. Follow escalation in SOP-P1-L2-03 if discrepancies are found.

Acceptance criteria
- Lubricant applied is CFW-LUB-652 with no evidence of cross-contamination.
- Application points are clean, dry except for the intended lubricant film, and free of excess buildup.
- Quench operations meet the quench delay maximum for Ring Rolling heat treat furnace #3 (EQ-P1-L2-HT03) of 24 seconds.
- Maintenance log entries completed and consistent with SOP-P1-L2-01 and SOP-P1-L2-02.
title: Lubrication and fluids - Ring Rolling heat treat furnace #3

# MM-P1-L2-RR01 - Maintenance manual - Ring Rolling radial ring rolling mill #1
Revision: Rev F  
Supersedes: Rev E  
Plant: P1, line P1-L2  
Equipment: EQ-P1-L2-RR01

Scope
This document defines required maintenance actions for Ring Rolling radial ring rolling mill #1 (EQ-P1-L2-RR01) for routine clamp and bearing tasks. Use this manual in conjunction with ECN-2026-041, SOP-P1-L2-01, and SOP-P1-L2-04.

Tools
- Torque wrench capable of the mandrel clamp bolt torque specification  
- Clean lint-free rags and approved grease application tools  
- Personal protective equipment as required by SOP-P1-L2-01

Procedure
1. Prepare the machine following SOP-P1-L2-01 lockout/tagout and verification procedures.  
2. Access the mandrel clamp assembly per SOP-P1-L2-04 instructions.  
3. Clean clamp bolt threads and bearing contact faces with a lint-free rag.  
4. Apply lubricant to threads only when specified by ECN-2026-041.  
5. Tighten the mandrel clamp bolts to the mandrel clamp bolt torque for Ring Rolling radial ring rolling mill #1 (EQ-P1-L2-RR01) is 395 N·m. Use a calibrated torque wrench and follow the tightening sequence described in ECN-2026-041.  
6. Rotate the main roll by hand to verify freedom of movement after clamping. If binding is detected, re-inspect clamp faces and repeat bolt torque step.  
7. Lubricate the main roll bearings at the main roll bearing lubrication interval for Ring Rolling radial ring rolling mill #1 (EQ-P1-L2-RR01) is 175 hours using the grease type specified in SOP-P1-L2-04. Record lubrication on the equipment log.

Acceptance criteria
- Mandrel clamp bolts remain at specified torque and show no external leakage from the clamp area.  
- Main roll rotates freely without vibration or binding after maintenance.  
- Lubrication entries are recorded per SOP-P1-L2-01 and ECN-2026-041.  
- Any deviations or failures are documented and routed per ECN-2026-041 for corrective action.
title: Maintenance manual - Ring Rolling radial ring rolling mill #1

# MM-P1-L4-HT03 Maintenance manual - Heat Treat heat treat furnace #3
Revision: Rev D — This revision supersedes Rev C  
Plant: P1, line P1-L4  
Equipment: EQ-P1-L4-HT03

Related documents: ECN-2026-002, SB-1006, SOP-P1-L4-02

Scope
This document defines the preventive maintenance and verification steps required for Heat Treat heat treat furnace #3 (EQ-P1-L4-HT03). It covers inspection, cleaning, sensor calibration verification, control setpoint check, and record completion necessary to return the furnace to service after maintenance.

Tools
- Hand tools and non-sparking cleaning tools appropriate for furnace internals.  
- Insulation-safe inspection mirror and flashlight.  
- Calibrated thermocouple reference and data logger compliant with SOP-P1-L4-02.  
- Appropriate personal protective equipment (PPE) per SB-1006.

Procedure
- De-energize and lock out the furnace per plant lockout procedures referenced in SOP-P1-L4-02.  
- Inspect furnace chamber lining and hearth for loose insulation and mechanical damage; remove debris and clean surfaces with non-abrasive methods.  
- Verify control system diagnostics and backup controller configuration against baseline in ECN-2026-002.  
- The austenitizing setpoint for Heat Treat heat treat furnace #3 (EQ-P1-L4-HT03) is 880 °C. Confirm the setpoint in the control interface matches this value.  
- Verify thermocouple function by performing a calibration check using the calibrated reference. The thermocouple calibration interval for Heat Treat heat treat furnace #3 (EQ-P1-L4-HT03) is 75 days. Document calibration results and replace thermocouples if readings exceed allowable drift per SOP-P1-L4-02.  
- Restore power and perform a controlled heat cycle to confirm stable control response and alarm function.

Acceptance criteria
- Control setpoint matches the required austenitizing setpoint and is stable under load.  
- Thermocouple calibration results are within limits defined in SOP-P1-L4-02 and recorded in maintenance log.  
- No loose insulation or contaminants remain in the chamber.  
- All maintenance actions recorded and cross-referenced to ECN-2026-002 and SB-1006 where applicable.
title: Maintenance manual - Heat Treat heat treat furnace #3

# MM-P2-L1-RR01 Maintenance manual - Hot Forge radial ring rolling mill #1
Revision: Rev B — This revision supersedes Rev A
Plant: P2, line P2-L1
Equipment: EQ-P2-L1-RR01

Scope
This document defines maintenance actions required to preserve safe and reliable operation of Hot Forge radial ring rolling mill #1 (EQ-P2-L1-RR01). It covers clamp bolt verification and main roll bearing lubrication as the primary recurring tasks. Refer to ECN-2026-023 for engineering changes and SOP-P2-L1-01 and SOP-P2-L1-02 for shop procedures and lockout/tagout.

Tools
- Torque wrench calibrated to cover specified torque range
- Clean lint-free rags and approved cleaning solvent
- Manufacturer-specified grease pump or lubricant dispenser per SOP-P2-L1-02
- Inspection mirror and flashlight
- Personal protective equipment per SOP-P2-L1-01

Procedure
- Verify safe isolation and lockout in accordance with SOP-P2-L1-01 before beginning work.
- Clean the mandrel clamp area to remove scale and debris. Inspect for visible wear, cracks, or distortion. If defects are present, tag out and escalate per ECN-2026-023.
- Set the torque wrench and tighten mandrel clamp bolts to the mandrel clamp bolt torque for Hot Forge radial ring rolling mill #1 (EQ-P2-L1-RR01) is 430 N·m. Tighten bolts in a star pattern to achieve even clamp load. Record each bolt torque in the maintenance log referenced by SOP-P2-L1-02.
- Access the main roll bearing lubrication port. Purge old lubricant if contamination is suspected. Refill using the approved lubricant and dispenser. Adhere to the main roll bearing lubrication interval for Hot Forge radial ring rolling mill #1 (EQ-P2-L1-RR01) is 275 hours for scheduling only; verify lubricant type per SOP-P2-L1-02.
- After maintenance, remove tags, restore energy, and perform a functional check per SOP-P2-L1-01.

Acceptance criteria
- All mandrel clamp bolts display documented torque values equal to the specified mandrel clamp bolt torque for Hot Forge radial ring rolling mill #1 (EQ-P2-L1-RR01) is 430 N·m.
- Main roll bearings show no signs of leakage or overheating after operation and lubrication was performed according to the main roll bearing lubrication interval for Hot Forge radial ring rolling mill #1 (EQ-P2-L1-RR01) is 275 hours scheduling.
- Maintenance actions and references to ECN-2026-023, SOP-P2-L1-01, and SOP-P2-L1-02 are recorded in the equipment maintenance log.
title: Maintenance manual - Hot Forge radial ring rolling mill #1

# MM-P2-L3-RR01-S1 - Lubrication and fluids - Machining radial ring rolling mill #1
Revision: Rev D (this revision supersedes Rev C)  
Plant: P2, line P2-L3

Scope
- Routine lubrication and fluid checks for Machining radial ring rolling mill #1 (EQ-P2-L3-RR01).

Tools
- Manufacturer-approved dispensing equipment compatible with lubricant part number CFW-LUB-225.
- Clean lint-free rags, drip trays, and fluid capture containers.
- Personal protective equipment as required by site SOP.

Procedure
1. Verify machine is isolated per site lockout procedures and reference SOP-P2-L3-05 before any fluid handling.
2. Confirm system reservoirs and delivery lines are visually free of contamination and external leaks.
3. Use manufacturer-approved dispensing equipment to top up reservoirs with lubricant part number CFW-LUB-225 only. Do not mix with other lubricants.
4. Cycle lubrication system per mechanical control to ensure flow to bearings and delivery points. Capture and inspect return fluid for contamination.
5. Dispose of captured waste fluids and used wiping materials per site environmental procedures and reference SB-1036 for hazardous waste handling guidance.
6. Record lubricant part number CFW-LUB-225 and volume added in equipment lubrication log. Reference MM-P2-L3-RR01 for baseline system diagrams and reservoir locations.

Acceptance criteria
- Reservoirs contain lubricant part number CFW-LUB-225 and show no visible water, metal particulate, or foreign matter.
- No active external leaks observed at delivery lines, fittings, or housings after circulation.
- Machine fluid condition and documentation are compliant with MM-P2-L3-RR01 and SOP-P2-L3-05 requirements.
- Machine ready statement validated for rings up to the maximum ring outer diameter for Machining radial ring rolling mill #1 (EQ-P2-L3-RR01) is 1115 mm.

- SB-1036
- SOP-P2-L3-05

# MM-P3-L2-HT03 — Maintenance manual - Ring Rolling heat treat furnace #3
Revision: Rev C (supersedes Rev B)
Plant: P3, line P3-L2
Equipment: EQ-P3-L2-HT03

Related documents: SB-1015, SB-1041, SOP-P3-L2-01

Scope
This manual provides required maintenance and verification steps for Ring Rolling heat treat furnace #3 (EQ-P3-L2-HT03). It covers inspection, thermocouple calibration, controller verification, and austenitizing setpoint confirmation to ensure consistent heat treatment for ring rolling operations at P3-L2.

Tools
- Digital thermocouple calibrator compatible with installed TC type
- Insulated high-temperature probe and protective gloves
- Controller interface cable and laptop with vendor software
- Authorized lockout/tagout kit
- Manufacturer service checklist per SB-1015

Procedure
- Isolate and lock out EQ-P3-L2-HT03 per SOP-P3-L2-01 before any work.
- Visually inspect furnace chamber, insulation, and element connections following SB-1041 guidance.
- Access the controller and record current configuration. Confirm the austenitizing setpoint for Ring Rolling heat treat furnace #3 (EQ-P3-L2-HT03) is 870 °C.
- Remove thermocouple head and perform calibration against the digital thermocouple calibrator. The thermocouple calibration interval for Ring Rolling heat treat furnace #3 (EQ-P3-L2-HT03) is 65 days; record calibration results on the maintenance log.
- If thermocouple drift exceeds vendor tolerance on the calibrator, replace the thermocouple and retest.
- Verify controller reads the replacement thermocouple and confirm setpoint remains at 870 °C.
- Restore wiring and secure head assembly. Remove lockout/tagout and return equipment to service per SOP-P3-L2-01.
- Attach completed maintenance checklist to the equipment file and reference SB-1015 and SB-1041 as applicable.

Acceptance criteria
- Controller displays and maintains the austenitizing setpoint for Ring Rolling heat treat furnace #3 (EQ-P3-L2-HT03) at 870 °C.
- Thermocouple calibration performed within the thermocouple calibration interval for Ring Rolling heat treat furnace #3 (EQ-P3-L2-HT03) is 65 days and recorded.
- No physical damage or loose electrical connections detected; maintenance checklist completed and filed.
title: Maintenance manual - Ring Rolling heat treat furnace #3

text:
# MM-P3-L4-HT02 - Maintenance manual - Heat Treat heat treat furnace #2
Revision: Rev F  
Supersedes: Rev E  
Plant: P3, line P3-L4  
Equipment: EQ-P3-L4-HT02

Scope
This manual defines preventive maintenance and calibration actions for Heat Treat heat treat furnace #2 (EQ-P3-L4-HT02) at Plant P3, line P3-L4. It applies to mechanical, electrical, and instrumentation items required to maintain safe and repeatable austenitizing cycles. Refer to ECN-2026-001 for design changes and SOP-P3-L4-02 and SOP-P3-L4-05 for operational interaction procedures.

Tools
- Insulation resistance meter
- Digital multimeter compatible with thermocouple measurement
- Thermocouple probe and calibration bath (vendor supplied)
- Hand tools for access panels and sensor replacement
- Lockout/tagout kit per SOP-P3-L4-02

Procedure
1. Prepare equipment per SOP-P3-L4-05 and establish lockout/tagout.  
2. Verify chamber integrity and access panels removed to expose thermocouple junctions and heaters.  
3. Check thermocouple wiring for continuity and secure connections to the control thermocouple input.  
4. Perform thermocouple calibration for EQ-P3-L4-HT02 using a traceable reference. The thermocouple calibration interval for Heat Treat heat treat furnace #2 (EQ-P3-L4-HT02) is 130 days. Record before and after readings on the maintenance log referenced in SOP-P3-L4-02.  
5. Confirm controller setpoints and program parameters match documented process recipe. The austenitizing setpoint for Heat Treat heat treat furnace #2 (EQ-P3-L4-HT02) is 885 °C. Do not modify the setpoint without authorization per ECN-2026-001.  
6. Reassemble access panels, remove lockout/tagout, and return the furnace to service following SOP-P3-L4-05.

Acceptance criteria
- Thermocouple calibration results are within allowable limits as defined in SOP-P3-L4-02 and documented in the maintenance record.  
- Controller readback at the austenitizing setpoint is stable and indicates the setpoint value specified above.  
- No alarms or fault codes remain after return to service.  
Related documents: ECN-2026-001, SOP-P3-L4-02, SOP-P3-L4-05
title: Maintenance manual - Heat Treat heat treat furnace #2

# MM-P3-L4-HT02-S2 Fastener inspection and torque - Heat Treat heat treat furnace #2
Revision: Rev F (supersedes Rev E)
Plant: P3, line P3-L4
Equipment: EQ-P3-L4-HT02

Scope
This document defines the inspection, lubrication, and torque verification process for structural and service fasteners on Heat Treat heat treat furnace #2 (EQ-P3-L4-HT02). Use this procedure for scheduled inspections and any time components are disassembled and reassembled. Refer to MM-P3-L4-HT02, SB-1043, and SOP-P3-L4-01 for related requirements and record formats.

Tools
- Calibrated torque wrench
- Socket set appropriate to fastener heads
- Clean lint-free cloths
- Approved lubricant: CFW-LUB-371
- Fastener tagging materials and inspection log

Procedure
1. Visual inspection: Check each accessible fastener for thread damage, corrosion, and evidence of loosening. Tag any fastener that exhibits visible defects and follow nonconforming part procedure in SB-1043.
2. Clean: Remove surface contamination and old lubricant with lint-free cloths. Ensure mounting surfaces are clean and dry prior to reassembly.
3. Lubrication: Apply the specified lubricant to threads where manufacturer or MM-P3-L4-HT02 requires lubrication. Use lubricant part number CFW-LUB-371 exclusively for EQ-P3-L4-HT02 fasteners where lubrication is specified.
4. Reassembly and torque: Tighten fasteners using a calibrated torque wrench. Do not improvise torque values in the field. Apply final torque values as specified in MM-P3-L4-HT02 or SOP-P3-L4-01. Record torque values and technician initials in the inspection log.
5. Functional note: When performing operations that affect quench timing, confirm that the quench delay maximum for Heat Treat heat treat furnace #2 (EQ-P3-L4-HT02) is 20 seconds and document verification per SOP-P3-L4-01.

Acceptance criteria
- No loose, missing, or damaged fasteners remain on EQ-P3-L4-HT02.
- Fasteners requiring lubricant have CFW-LUB-371 applied where specified.
- Recorded torque values match the references MM-P3-L4-HT02 or SOP-P3-L4-01 and are entered into the equipment log.
- Any nonconformances are processed per SB-1043 and cleared before returning equipment to service.

Related documents
MM-P3-L4-HT02, SB-1043, SOP-P3-L4-01
title: Fastener inspection and torque - Heat Treat heat treat furnace #2

# MM-P3-L4-RR01 — Maintenance manual - Heat Treat radial ring rolling mill #1
Revision: Rev F (supersedes Rev E)  
Plant: P3, line P3-L4  
Equipment: EQ-P3-L4-RR01

## Scope
This document provides maintenance steps specific to Heat Treat radial ring rolling mill #1 (EQ-P3-L4-RR01) at Plant P3, line P3-L4. It addresses clamp bolt torque and main roll bearing lubrication activities required for safe, repeatable operation. Related documents: SB-1028, SOP-P3-L4-02, SOP-P3-L4-03.

## Tools
- Calibrated torque wrench capable of applying the specified clamp bolt torque.
- Clean lint-free rags and approved bearing lubricant.
- Inspection light and mirror.
- Lockout/tagout kit per SOP-P3-L4-02.

## Procedure
1. Perform lockout/tagout as directed by SOP-P3-L4-02 and verify energy isolation.
2. Access mandrel clamp assembly following SB-1028 disassembly sequence.
3. Inspect clamping hardware for visible wear, deformation, or contamination. Clean mating surfaces with lint-free rag.
4. Install clamp bolts finger-tight to seat components. Using the calibrated torque wrench, apply the mandrel clamp bolt torque for Heat Treat radial ring rolling mill #1 (EQ-P3-L4-RR01) is 605 N·m. Follow tightening pattern from SB-1028 to ensure even seating.
5. Remove access panels to reach main roll bearings. Clean bearing housings and inspect for metal debris or lubricant breakdown.
6. Lubricate main roll bearings in accordance with bearing supplier recommendations and SOP-P3-L4-03. Note the main roll bearing lubrication interval for Heat Treat radial ring rolling mill #1 (EQ-P3-L4-RR01) is 135 hours. Record lubricant type, batch, and time-in-service in maintenance log.
7. Reassemble guards and remove lockout/tagout only after verifying no tools or debris remain.

## Acceptance criteria
- Mandrel clamp bolts remain at specified torque with no visible clamp misalignment or joint separation.
- Main roll bearings show clean lubricant appearance and smooth rotation; no abnormal noise on manual spin.
- Maintenance actions and lubricant application recorded and traceable to SB-1028, SOP-P3-L4-02, SOP-P3-L4-03.
- Machine returns to service only when all criteria above are met and authorization obtained per SOP-P3-L4-02.
title: Maintenance manual - Heat Treat radial ring rolling mill #1

# QS-CFW-1140-78 - Quality specification - axle hub CFW-1140-78 (4140)  
Revision: Rev E · Plant: P1 · Parts: CFW-1140-78  
This revision supersedes Rev D.

Scope
- Defines material and dimensional quality requirements for axle hub CFW-1140-78 (CFW-1140-78) produced in Plant P1. Applies to forged and heat-treated parts delivered for final machining and assembly.

Requirements table

| Characteristic | Requirement | Notes |
|---|---:|---|
| Material | 4140 per procurement specification | Verify heat lot traceability on packing |
| Hardness | 27-32 HRC | Hardness is measured on finished, machined surface |
| Bore diameter tolerance | ±0.08 mm | Applies to specified bore feature on drawing for CFW-1140-78 |
| Maximum forging weight | 74.6 kg | Weigh part after forging and cleaning; do not exceed for press capacity |

Inspection method
- Visual: Inspect for surface discontinuities, laps, and cold shuts. Reject parts with visible forging defects that compromise fit or function.  
- Dimensional: Measure bore diameter using appropriate gauge or CMM; verify conformance to bore diameter tolerance ±0.08 mm. Record measured values on inspection record.  
- Hardness: Perform hardness testing on finished, machined surface using Rockwell method; report values and ensure they fall within 27-32 HRC. Calibrate hardness tester per plant calibration program.  
- Weight: Weigh forgings after cleaning and verify maximum forging weight 74.6 kg is not exceeded for press and handling constraints.

Nonconformance handling
- Isolate nonconforming parts and tag to prevent use. Create nonconformance record and include material heat lot and forging information.  
- For dimensional or hardness failures, evaluate cause (process, heat treat, machining) and disposition (rework, reheat, or scrap) based on engineering review.  
- Document corrective actions and prevent recurrence. Retain inspection records with part traceability for audit and customer review.
title: Quality specification - axle hub CFW-1140-78 (4140)

# QS-CFW-1159-60 — Quality specification - track link CFW-1159-60 (15B37)
Revision: Rev F  
Plant: P3  
Parts: CFW-1159-60  
This revision supersedes Rev E.

Scope
This document defines the quality requirements for track link CFW-1159-60 (CFW-1159-60) produced at Plant P3. It applies to forged and finished parts delivered to internal assembly or external customers where the part number CFW-1159-60 is specified.

Requirements table

| Attribute | Requirement |
|---|---|
| Part number | CFW-1159-60 |
| Hardness | The hardness range for track link CFW-1159-60 (CFW-1159-60) is 36-40 HRC. |
| Bore diameter tolerance | The bore diameter tolerance for track link CFW-1159-60 (CFW-1159-60) is ±0.01 mm. |
| Maximum forging weight | The maximum forging weight for track link CFW-1159-60 (CFW-1159-60) is 80.0 kg. |
| Surface condition | Free of visible laps, seams, and forging defects that affect fit or function. |
| Identification | Parts must be legibly marked with part number CFW-1159-60 and batch identifier per plant marking procedure. |

Inspection method
Hardness shall be verified on a representative sample using a Rockwell hardness tester calibrated to traceable standards. Measure across the hardened section avoiding quenched surfaces and distortion marks; report results against the hardness range specified above. Bore diameter shall be checked with calibrated bore gages or pin gages to verify the tolerance stated above. Forging weight shall be recorded on the heat lot record and verified against the maximum forging weight specified above. Surface condition and identification shall be visually inspected under standard shop lighting and recorded on the inspection record.

Nonconformance handling
Any part failing to meet the requirements in the table shall be segregated, tagged, and recorded. Nonconforming parts will be dispositioned by authorized quality personnel according to the plant nonconformance procedure. Rework or repair requires documented approval and verification that the actions do not violate the hardness, bore tolerance, or forging weight requirements listed above.
title: Quality specification - track link CFW-1159-60 (15B37)

text:
# QS-CFW-1392-34 Quality specification - crankshaft blank CFW-1392-34 (4340)
Revision: Rev E  
Plant: P1  
Parts: CFW-1392-34  
This revision supersedes Rev D.

Scope
This quality specification applies to the manufacture, inspection, and acceptance of crankshaft blank CFW-1392-34 produced from 4340 material at Plant P1. It establishes dimensional, hardness, and weight requirements for incoming and in-process inspection and final release.

Requirements table
| Requirement | Specification |
|---|---|
| Material | 4340 (as specified on part drawing) |
| Hardness (as received) | 34-37 HRC. |
| Bore diameter tolerance | ±0.04 mm. |
| Maximum forging weight | 6.7 kg. |
| Visual | Free of cracks, laps, and forging-scale entrapment that affect machinability |

Inspection method
- Hardness: Verify hardness on representative locations using a calibrated Rockwell tester following manufacturer procedure. Record results on inspection record and compare to 34-37 HRC. Hardness readings outside this range constitute a nonconformance.
- Bore diameter: Measure bore diameter with calibrated bore gauge or internal micrometer; results must meet ±0.04 mm. Document measurements on dimensional inspection form.
- Weight: Use calibrated scale to determine forging weight; confirm it does not exceed 6.7 kg. Record actual weight on the work order.
- Visual: Inspect under consistent lighting for forging defects that impact function or machining. Reject parts with disqualifying defects.

Nonconformance handling
Parts failing any requirement are segregated, tagged, and routed to quality for disposition. For hardness, bore, or weight nonconformances, complete a nonconformance report and document rejection reason and disposition. Rework is permitted only if a documented rework plan is approved by Quality and returns the part to full compliance with this specification. Scrap is dispositioned per Plant P1 scrap procedure. - Segregate any part failing the Requirements table. Document nonconformance on the plant NCR form and notify Quality. Evaluate cause and containment; corrective actions must include rework, reheat, or rejection as appropriate. Parts reworked shall be re-inspected to the same methods above before release.
title: Quality specification - connecting rod CFW-7434-20 (1045)

# QS-CFW-9335-36 - Quality specification - gear blank CFW-9335-36 (8620)  
Revision: Rev F (supersedes Rev E)  
Plant: P3  
Parts: CFW-9335-36

Scope
- This document defines the quality requirements, inspection method, and nonconformance handling for gear blank CFW-9335-36 (CFW-9335-36) manufactured from 8620 in Plant P3.

Requirements table

| Requirement | Specification |
|---|---|
| Material identification | 8620, traceable to batch certificate |
| Hardness range | The hardness range for gear blank CFW-9335-36 (CFW-9335-36) is 36-41 HRC. |
| Bore diameter tolerance | The bore diameter tolerance for gear blank CFW-9335-36 (CFW-9335-36) is ±0.04 mm. |
| Maximum forging weight | The maximum forging weight for gear blank CFW-9335-36 (CFW-9335-36) is 107.9 kg. |
| Surface condition | Free of detrimental laps, seams, and cold shuts; acceptable scale removal per standard shop practice |

Inspection method
- Visual inspection: Inspect each part for surface discontinuities and forging defects against the surface condition requirement.
- Dimensional inspection: Verify bore diameter using calibrated bore gauge or equivalent measuring device. Record measured value and confirm compliance with the bore diameter tolerance specified above.
- Hardness inspection: Verify hardness using a calibrated Rockwell hardness tester in accordance with standard practice. Ensure readings fall within the hardness range specified above. Take representative hardness measurements at locations representative of the component cross section; record individual readings with part identification.
- Weight verification: Confirm forged weight does not exceed the maximum forging weight specified above by using the plant scale and traceable measurement procedures.
- Record retention: Maintain inspection records with part identification and inspector signature in the quality system.

Nonconformance handling
- Parts that fail any requirement in the table are to be segregated, tagged, and recorded as nonconforming.
- Engineering disposition is required for all nonconforming parts; allowable dispositions include rework, repair, or scrap as authorized by engineering.
- Reworked parts must be reinspected to the same requirements and have records updated to reflect disposition and final inspection results.
- Rejects shall be disposed of or returned to processing only after documented approval.
title: Quality specification - gear blank CFW-9335-36 (8620)

# SOP-P3-L3-02 Product changeover - Machining line
Revision: Rev F — This revision supersedes Rev E  
Plant: P3, line P3-L3  
Equipment: EQ-P3-L3-SB01, EQ-P3-L3-CN02, EQ-P3-L3-HP03

Purpose: Provide standardized steps for product changeover on the machining line to ensure safe, repeatable transitions and maintain part quality.

1. Preconditions
   1.1. Verify previous run complete and parts removed from EQ-P3-L3-SB01 and EQ-P3-L3-CN02.  
   1.2. Confirm maintenance status of EQ-P3-L3-HP03 per SB-1005 and SB-1010.  
   1.3. Confirm tools, fixtures and program files staged for the new product per SOP-P3-L3-04.

2. PPE
   2.1. All personnel must don required PPE before entering the equipment envelope.  
   2.2. Ensure machine guards and interlocks are functional and not bypassed.

3. Mechanical setup
   3.1. Lockout/tagout sequence: follow plant LOTO procedure before any mechanical adjustment.  
   3.2. Check fasteners on fixtures and collars; verify condition of tooling clamping faces.  
   3.3. For Machining hydraulic forging press #3 (EQ-P3-L3-HP03) set main ram bolt to specified torque: The main ram bolt torque for Machining hydraulic forging press #3 (EQ-P3-L3-HP03) is 1600 N·m. Only trained personnel shall apply and record this torque.

4. Lubrication
   4.1. Replenish hydraulic and ram lubrication before first cycle. The lubricant part number for Machining hydraulic forging press #3 (EQ-P3-L3-HP03) is CFW-LUB-254. Use only the specified lubricant.

5. Control and program
   5.1. Load program and verify offsets. Dry-run cycle with guards in place to confirm no interference.

6. Trial run and inspection
   6.1. Run pilot parts and perform dimensional and visual checks. Document disposition per SOP-P3-L3-04.

7. Handover and documentation
   7.1. Complete the changeover checklist and attach to batch record. Reference SB-1005, SB-1010 for maintenance history.

Sign-off
- Operator: ______________________  
- Lead: ______________________  
- Maintenance: ______________________

Related documents: SB-1005, SB-1010, SOP-P3-L3-04
title: Product changeover - Machining line
